items.title: Target delays key emissions goals
items.summary: Target has become the latest major company to downgrade its emission goals.

items.title: 7 steps toward a future-friendly EPR strategy
items.summary: Understand the legal implications: It’s not just about packaging. Fees can vary widely, so estimate your company’s exposure in order to prioritize.

items.title: First-of-a-kind label focuses on compact products
items.summary: Companies wanting to trumpet the environmental benefits associated with using less packaging can now apply for a new “compact product” certification that its creators say is the first of its kind.

items.title: UN climate chief urges EU to ‘throw itself behind’ COP31
items.summary: In an address to a European Parliament committee, executive secretary of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), Simon Stiell, has called on countries to drive greater progress ahead of this year's summit.

items.title: Boardroom Briefing: Building the business case on packaging reforms
items.summary: edie's Boardroom Briefing series provides senior business leaders with authoritative analysis of key sustainability issues and the material impacts that inaction will have on the bottom line.

items.title: Welsh Government unveils plans for new publicly owned energy company
items.summary: The Welsh Government is consulting on plans to create a single publicly owned energy company for Wales, bringing together existing energy delivery functions under one organisation.

items.title: ONE WEEK to go until edie’s Sustainable Supply Chains Summit
items.summary: Join us on 17 September for a unique opportunity to gain expert-led insights through thought leadership and industry panels featuring top professionals in sustainability, supply chain and procurement.

items.title: Government confirms £1.5bn to boost NHS climate adaptation
items.summary: With August confirmed as the world's joint warmest month on record, the UK Government has announced that it is investing over £1.5bn to improve the NHS' resilience.

items.title: Google’s €13bn AI data centre plan in Finland to be supported by nuclear power
items.summary: Google has unveiled its largest single investment in Europe, a €13bn plan to support AI and digital infrastructure investments in Finland, that will be powered by a variety of clean energy projects and a major nuclear supply deal.

items.title: Nominations open for edie’s 30 Under 30 Class of 2027
items.summary: edie’s 30 Under 30 is back for 2027, celebrating ambitious young professionals turning sustainability ambition into meaningful action across business.
